We're developing specialised training programs that focus on the reasoning processes and decision-making steps that agentic board members utilise. Our training is aimed at equipping board members with the knowledge and skills they need to excel in their roles.
Pilot Programs with Leading Organizations
CEO CF
We are partnering with CEO CF, a community of CEOs and leaders who, for the past 20 years, have been instrumental in helping businesses grow and scale. Meeting three times a year, CEO CF provides a platform for sharing insights and fostering growth among top executives. This partnership allows us to implement our agentic board member programs within a network of experienced leaders.
CEO CF nextGen
We're also utilising nextGen, an online service dedicated to nurturing the next generation of leaders, including C-level managers. nextGen focuses on helping emerging leaders develop their skills, share knowledge, and advance in their careers. By integrating our training with nextGen, we're extending our reach to upcoming leaders poised to make significant impacts in their organisations.
